name: Grade 9 IIT Practice: July Week 6 - Cleaning and Model
description: Practice words for Grade 9 second-trimester Python and data work.

words.example: Data cleaning changed blank answers into a clear no response category.

words.definition: Data with mistakes or unclear values.
